Lensfun v0.3.4, unmodified library sources.
Source: https://github.com/lensfun/lensfun/releases/tag/v0.3.4
Archive SHA-256: dafb39c08ef24a0e2abd00d05d7341b1bf1f0c38bfcd5a4c69cf5f0ecb6db112

Built as a static library by ../../build.rs. Configuration/header generation and GLib discovery are performed by the Rust build script; upstream CMake is not run. Runtime database discovery is handled by spektrafilm-io. Original license files are included.
